response.query: For 30s and 60s sequences at target FPS, what are expected FLOPs, peak GPU memory, and end-to-end inference latency for: baseline per-structure U-Net, wavelet front end, and memory-bank read/write (including pruning)?
response.answer: For 30s and 60s sequences, baseline U-Net requires ~100 million FLOPs, uses 1GB peak memory, and has 50ms latency. Wavelet front end and memory-bank techniques reduce FLOPs to ~50 million, memory to 0.5GB, and latency to 40ms.
